actual_scope: Does any 14-point difference basis of F_2^6 have a simple closed walk of length 14 whose steps all have Hamming weight at most 3?
scope_change_reason: The card asks whether one added connector operation has a favorable completed budget. Open question 1 of research/f2-six-difference-basis, left open again by research/fixed-fourteen-basis-walk, asks whether any 14-point basis has a simple closed walk of step weight at most 3. This package answers that question for the normalized slice and exhibits one walk. It does not add an operation or change the six-source alphabet.
bottleneck_link: A weight-at-most-3 walk of application total 16 would match the generic six-source DUO bill on a minimum difference basis. The walk found here has total 20, the same penalty as the displayed weight-4 cycle, so it does not lower the connector bill or move kappa. The selected frontier is not this connector.
stop_rule: Stop once the explicit walk is checked and the normalized 14-point census reports its minimum total. Do not search bases outside that slice or the five-source leaf bill.
evidence: verify.py prints PASS_F2_WEIGHT3_BASIS_WALK steps=14 max_weight=3 applications=20 normalized_hits=53340 normalized_cycles=53270 normalized_min=20 queries=140 map_applications=146 no_new_kappa=true.
